our_interpretation: The assessable forecast concerns what happens conditional on a collapse; it does not predict a dated collapse.
Absorption includes a transfer of the core team or business to a large technology company while a residual entity survives. Ordinary investments and commercial partnerships do not qualify.
Collapse means a failure to continue the substantive business independently, not a falling valuation or an ordinary restructuring.
The alleged concealment motive and the unquantified probability of shutdown cannot be separately established by transaction records.
criteria.support_condition: A documented collapse of either company is resolved through a rescue absorption of its core business or team by a large technology company.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented collapse ends in permanent closure without such absorption, or another completed disposition inconsistent with the predicted mechanism.
